$comment: MASTER LIST of every 'situation' — a way of slicing/comparing/pairing the output of a metric. The process applies a situation to a metric result. Add new situations with process/addSituation.mjs. 'module' resolves relative to process/lib/situations/.

situations.title: Per-user — one series per user and the team they control
situations.desc: Pass-through, presented per USER. The engine calls each army a 'team'; here a team is defined as the User controlling it. Each row carries userId + name and the teamID the user controls.

situations.title: Mirror matchup — pair each player with the opponent at the mirrored start position
situations.pairing: reflect each team's start position across the midpoint of all starts; pair with the nearest opposing-allyteam start
situations.desc: Produces side-by-side pairs (you vs your mirror) so a player's composition can be compared against the structurally-equivalent opponent. Falls back to commander-spawn coordinates from the action log when no demo roster is supplied.
